entities.name: Dejan Vinčič
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dejan Vinčić is a Slovenian volleyball player who plays for Alpacem Kanal. With the Slovenia national team, he was the runner-up of the European Volleyball Championship three times, in 2015, 2019 and 2021. He also represented Slovenia at the 2024 Summer Olympics.
